acceptanceCriteria.ac: Calculate expected end date from start date + days assigned | Returns correct date using school calendar
Only count school days (from daep_school_calendar) | Skips holidays, weather days

Handle missing school calendar gracefully | Falls back to Mon-Fri business days

Display days remaining on placement cards | Text display (no color coding)
Show expected end date on placement cards | Date formatted as "MMM d, yyyy"
